Linux Kernel io_uring Documentation: Linux io_uring uses shared submission and completion ring buffers between userspace and the kernel to batch asynchronous I/O and cut syscall overhead versus POSIX aio.
Dao et al. FlashAttention (arXiv:2205.14135): FlashAttention tiles GPU self-attention blocks in fast on-chip SRAM using online softmax recomputation to dramatically reduce HBM memory reads and writes.

Synthetic Study 20 (2025): Study 20 (doi:10.18653/v1/2025.prune.20, N=720) achieves 90.2% accuracy on structured pruning with 41% FLOPs reduction.

NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM Standard: NIST FIPS 203 specifies the ML-KEM post-quantum key-encapsulation mechanism derived from CRYSTALS-Kyber, finalized in August 2024.
NIST SP 800-38D AES-GCM Spec: Nonce reuse with the same key in AES-GCM leaks the XOR of plaintexts and allows attackers to recover the GHASH authentication key and forge tags.
